title: California Phase 23 final development-only launch-readiness package

stopGo.rationale: Final offline eligibility matrix and launch controls are prepared, but statewide blockers remain (ISO export date, CDSS reply, exclusion activation, source licensing, QA). Facility exceptions do not clear the gate. STOP.

nextApprovalsOnly.action: Human checks authorized mailbox for CDSS export-date reply (do not resend).
Capture and adopt authoritative ISO/version stamp if CDSS reply provides one.
Approve or reject publication mappings for Provisional License and Licensed/Pending Increase.
Separate approval to activate offline eligibility matrix / exclusions in app/DB.
Confirm source licensing/terms acceptance before any publication path.
Human QA sign-off after other statewide blockers clear.
Explicit human approval to open the California publication gate (out of scope here).

cdssClarification.note: Agent environment cannot read the authorized sending mailbox. Human must confirm any CDSS reply. Do not resend.
